visual_requirements.description: One living Chinese dragon with blue-green skin, one head and one long coiling body; restrained naturalistic dragon rendering, no additional heads or borrowed franchise design.
Rain strikes scales and splashes from the moving body as an environmental association of the eastern Azure Dragon; no claim that it generates lightning, fire or magical beams.
Variant A at a Taoist temple threshold reflecting its door-deity use; variant B above the eastern mountain landscape of Kyoto reflecting its protection of the east.

aura: Dominance through living coiled dragon form, close low angle and rain; no emitted aura or added supernatural attack.
artistic_choices: The naturalistic serpentine Chinese dragon rendering, ordinary paired eyes and four limbs, scale detail, camera angles and rain intensity are editorial; the research specifies a blue-green Chinese dragon but no exact limb count.
Environmental rain follows c07 association, not a newly asserted weather-control power.

variants.prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of AZURE DRAGON, the blue-green Chinese dragon of the east and spring, living and awe-inspiring [azure-dragon-c01, azure-dragon-c02, azure-dragon-c14].
ANATOMY: exactly ONE dragon head, TWO natural eyes, ONE long continuous serpentine blue-green scaly dragon body with FOUR limbs, no duplicated heads or bodies; only visible claws where naturally attached, no wings or extra appendages. Shape of the traditional Chinese dragon, limbs and details are restrained editorial rendering where research specifies no exact count [azure-dragon-c01, azure-dragon-c07, azure-dragon-c14].
MOMENT: Surge down over the temple entrance, bend the huge coiled neck toward the viewer, foreclaws seize stone edge; water shears from wet scales.
POWER: Rain impacts its scales and sprays from its physical movement; rain is associated with this eastern dragon, not an emitted attack. No lightning, no fire, no magic rays or generic aura [azure-dragon-c07].
SCALE & CAMERA: ground-level near-front portrait: broad dragon head occupies upper center, coiled body frames it and two foreclaws grip foreground; one head only fills the frame. Camera magnifies presence without asserting a sourced numeric size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm break in dark storm clouds behind the head; walnut shadows, antique-gold rim light, blue-green scales as the sole saturated accent, heavy natural rain and spray.
SURFACE: rough wet scales, natural eyes with reflected light rather than emitted beams, hard claws, worn stone or wet mountain rocks.
SETTING: an austere Taoist temple doorway, tiny architectural details subordinate to dragon [azure-dragon-c05]
MOOD: commanding, sacred and overwhelming, alert guardian in active movement, never a calm decorative dragon or a statue.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-calligraphy, logo, border, watermark; no extra heads, eyes, legs, horns, tails or unrelated appendages; no franchise/film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons. One complete square native image.
variants.notes: Root melihat PNG native: satu kepala naga hidup biru-hijau, dua mata, tubuh memanjang koheren, dua kaki depan terbaca (belakang tertutup coil pada A); tidak ada kepala tambahan, dua tanduk bercabang/whiskers sebagai rendering tipe naga Cina editorial, hujan/cipratan fisik tanpa sinar serangan. Subjek mendominasi, bukan patung atau lanskap.
